entities.name: Gáspár Borbás

entities.summary: Gáspár Borbás was a Hungarian amateur association football player who competed in the 1912 Summer Olympics. He was in the Hungarian Olympic squad and played one match in the main tournament as well as two matches in the consolation tournament.
